_comment: Deploy config for the Firestore SECURITY RULES only — nothing else about this project
touches Firebase. The app is a static page on GitHub Pages that talks to Firestore over
REST with no SDK, so this file adds no dependency and no build step; it exists purely so
`firebase deploy --only firestore:rules` knows which file to publish.
Hosting is deliberately absent: GitHub Pages serves the site, and adding Firebase Hosting
here would give the app two live origins that could drift apart.
The indexes file is likewise absent. The gallery query (where pub == true, orderBy
updated) would use a composite index, but galList falls back to an unordered query when
it is missing, so the app works without one and the index is an optimisation to add from
